_meta.purpose: Keyword + traffic-source pattern for 7 >$1000 couture/BRIDAL houses → confirm/extend the $2000+ pattern for Maison's bridal/occasion play
_meta.source: SimilarWeb MCP, workflow wf_d034353e-51c. channels 12-mo 2025-06..2026-05; keywords 2026-03..2026-05

channels_pct.note: Display Ads 52.9% = Jun/Sep spike artifact, excluded

saiidkobeisy.com.nonbranded: occasion/bridal + Arabic wedding terms (فساتين افراح) + product (beaded/embroidered dress)

verawang.com.nonbranded: ranks GENERIC head terms 'wedding dresses'/'wedding dress'/'gown' (mega-brand can)

graceloveslace.com.nonbranded: 'wedding dresses' + product/fit ('lace/corset/basque wedding dress') + SIZING GUIDES ('how to measure bust')

pattern_verdict.confirms: organic+direct dominance (heritage houses Vera Wang ~98%, Manish 87%, Lihi 66%, Panache 80%, paid ~0-3%); branded discovery (80-85% for heritage); US + Anglophone diaspora geo; celebrity + occasion non-branded.
extends: OCCASION/BRIDAL is now the PRIMARY non-branded cluster (was secondary to celebrity in eveningwear couture) — bridal intent is more searchable.
Two non-Western FIRST-ORDER home markets: Gulf/MENA (Saiid Kobeisy Saudi 35.9% + Arabic keywords) + India (Manish 79%, Panache 67%).
Boutique bridal = high Referrals + Organic Social (Lihi Hod 17%+16%, Danielle Frankel 16.6%) → discovered via bridal directories/salons/Instagram, not name-search.
New non-branded sub-type: 'country + wedding designer' ('israeli wedding dress designers').
pattern_verdict.breaks_business_model_specific: DTC/mass-premium bridal breaks 2 couture rules: Grace Loves Lace = 33% paid (25.5% paid search) + ranks GENERIC 'wedding dresses' + only 22% branded. Vera Wang (mega) also ranks category head terms. → 'paid ~0 / no category head' is a couture-ATELIER effect, not universal.

maison_implications: Branded-discovery + owned-organic engine first, NOT paid (heritage houses paid ~0-3%). [High]
Build an occasion/BRIDAL hub for 'wedding'+occasion intent — the one non-branded surface worth ranking; pair with appointment/atelier page. [High]
Spend on paid ONLY if running a DTC/lower-price made-to-order line (Grace 33% paid vs atelier ~0). Paid = business-model lever, not bridal lever. [High]
Court bridal directories + salon/stockist referrals + Instagram for a boutique atelier (Lihi Hod/Danielle Frankel Ref+Social heavy). [Med]
Geo = strong home base + Anglophone/Asian diaspora tail (US/CA/UK/AU + SG). [Med]
Rank 'Vietnamese wedding dress designer / Vietnam couture atelier' (country+designer search); add Gulf/India language landing ONLY if targeting those (proven first-order bridal markets). [Med]
gated_caveats: Lihi Hod + Panache small/gated (few months); Saiid Kobeisy Display-spike excluded; branded % are estimates with brand-term leakage; referral/social referrer identities not itemized (directory/salon attribution inferred).
